title: Buck Clayton and Melba Liston
summary: He loves Buck Clayton and praises Melba Liston after she grabbed him at a Sunday session.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: What did you think of people like Sweets Edison and I saw you had a picture of ... used to work with Basie. Who was the trumpet player ... I think he's over in Europe but he's still around.
That's my man. I love him.
I see you have a picture there with Melvin Liston.
Oh, yeah. She can play, too, boy.
What did you think of Sweet S..
(That boy) can play some trombone! She grabbed me Sunday afternoon, yeah, I've never seen her ... that's when they were giving a session down ...
Oh, no, this is on Broadway, this big hotel kettle. They tore that down a couple of years ago, I think. She was tearing it down. But, anyway, he had the session on Sunday afternoon.
I don't know the name of it but they had Leonard Feather ... was giving the sessions. And, she (..?) I had never seen her. ... and know what she was doing, too.
